findings.message: The required verification includes test_bug_evidence_committed_with_ticket, which requires one intake commit containing both ticket.md and its changed evidence. Acceptance criterion 5 requires the checkpoint commit to contain only the ticket path, while the ticket ports intake and forbids its former live writer. Both requirements cannot hold for the same intake revision, and this test is outside the scope fence.
findings.paved_road: Decide how evidence is checkpointed: either permit the intake checkpoint to include that ticket's evidence, or explicitly change the existing evidence contract and fence every affected test and document.

findings.message: This verification test also requires an authored ticket and its existing evidence to appear in the same ticket commit; a universal ticket-path-only checkpoint contract conflicts with that expectation.
findings.paved_road: Specify whether authored ticket publication is exempt from the path-only checkpoint rule; if it is not, include this test and the affected publication path in the scope fence.
